scope: Fitted training rows. Cross-group neighbor exclusions are geometric queries.

advance_sampling_candidates.selection_rule: One unrepresented existing training advance history at tick 168. Require complete held-axis and nominal archival comparisons. Prefer larger nearest distance to existing timed states in fixed SI units. Break ties by episode ID. No validation results in selection.

distance: State RMS in the fixed 9 SI scales. Offset and nominal RMS are separate normalized request distances.
velocity_weights: Velocity response mass after replay mask and group/row weights, normalized by the full response mass.
